name: Mimasaka Nanao
source:
The president of the student council at Amagai Academy.

A young lady who has treated Kaoru like a pet since childhood.

She is an excellent student, beautiful, and has a princess-like personality, making her a central figure in the academy. She also belongs to the swimming club as a hobby.

In reality, she has a difficult personality and cannot be honest with those she likes...

[Translated from [url=https://erogamescape.dyndns.org/~ap2/ero/toukei_kaiseki/game_character.php?game=9978]erogamescape[/url]]
